teaching_moment: M5's teaching moment is the contrast itself — the student can only name what packaging adds because they read their own un-packaged failure first, and it triggers across skill variation because the artefact is theirs and Phase 1 of diagnose-and-resend forces quoted moments rather than summary. Today's largest addition, the done-done opener, adds a second self-adjudicated data point on a different axis (completion criteria, not the three failure-mode lenses) without naming any packaging vocabulary early, so it feeds the contrast rather than diluting it. The teaching moment survives across a reasonable skill range: even a persona whose M4 session passed the done-done audit cleanly still meets goal drift / context rot / plausible-but-wrong in Phase 1, because those are a different failure axis the audit doesn't screen for.
